_purpose: Seed roots + deterministic traversal rules for the recursive link-graph. crawl_seed.py --list expands each root into candidate child URLs OFFLINE (URL-template expansion — no network, deterministic). The network-heavy live traversal runs locally via tools/crawl_seed.ps1, whose JSON output is merged back with crawl_seed.py --import. Anticipatable signals discovered during a live crawl are routed to canonical-sources/anticipated_updates.json (the horizon seeder). Nothing here auto-ingests; every candidate is a review stub.

seeds.notes: The OLIR bulk JSON API + csf/download?olirids=all are broken (404/500). Per-reference download URLs resolve from the server-rendered .rip detail pages instead. The CPRT CSF 2.0 element graphs already carry the finalized set we ingest; this seed re-discovers newly finalized references.
Machine-readable CFR. Title 45 (HIPAA), Title 48 (FAR/DFARS), Title 17 (SEC). Point-in-time structure JSON per title.
Saved-query JSON feeds detect final rules / NPRMs per agency.
CELEX resolver for CRA (2024/2847), eIDAS2 (2024/1183), Data Act (2023/2854), Cyber Solidarity Act (2025/0038), EUCC (2024/0482). ELI RDF + SPARQL/Cellar available for machine-readable pulls.

ACSC ISM + NIST OSCAL content verified reachable via raw. FedRAMP OSCAL baseline paths 404 and api.github.com 403s via the proxy (GSA repo is outside the session's GitHub-MCP scope) — path-discovery-required, indexed not claimed.
The living FedRAMP org. FedRAMP/docs is legacy ('not a source of truth'); GSA/fedramp-automation archived 2025-07-01. Canonical data: FedRAMP/rules fedramp-consolidated-rules.json.
